title: Harvest (IBM 7950): Supercomputer for cryptanalysis at the NSA in the Cold War
summary: The IBM 7950 Harvest was a specialized supercomputer developed by IBM for the NSA during the Cold War, designed specifically for cryptanalysis and codebreaking operations. It represents a unique collaboration between commercial technology and government intelligence needs during the Cold War era.
problem_solved: Provided the NSA with unprecedented computational power to break enemy cryptographic codes and ciphers during the Cold War.
why_valuable: It offers insight into the intersection of government intelligence and computing technology, showing how classified hardware development shaped both cryptography and mainstream computing advances.
